advantages.title: Why Choose MUI Router
advantages.subtitle: AI API gateway built for developers worldwide
advantages.noVpnDesc: Proxied through Cloudflare's global edge network for barrier-free access. No overseas credit card or foreign account needed.
advantages.payPerUseDesc: No monthly fees, no subscriptions. Top up your wallet, pay only for what you use. Balance never expires, check spending anytime.
advantages.compatibleDesc: Fully compatible with OpenAI SDK and API format. Existing projects only need to change Base URL and API Key — zero migration cost.
advantages.passthroughDesc: Also supports native APIs from each provider, preserving all parameters and features. Claude's long context, Gemini's multimodal — nothing missed.

steps.title: Get Started in 3 Steps
steps.subtitle: From sign-up to API call in as fast as 1 minute
steps.step1Desc: Email registration, done in 30 seconds. Get your personal API Key instantly.
steps.step2Desc: Top up as needed, starting from $1. Supports various payment methods.
steps.step3Desc: Replace the Base URL — no other code changes needed.

metadata.title: Pricing
metadata.description: Official OpenAI and Gemini model prices. No subscriptions, pay as you go.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: No subscription plans and no package caps. This page lists the latest public prices from OpenAI and Gemini so you can compare model costs at a glance.

summary.noSubscriptionDescription: No plans, no monthly seat fees, and no package-based limits.
summary.officialDescription: All numbers here are provider-published reference prices, not MUI Router markups.

pricing.actualBillingNotice: MUI Router bills by the model pricing configured in the dashboard. This page is only a public price reference.
pricing.scopeNotice: Only core text and multimodal token pricing is included here. Audio, image generation, Live API, Batch, grounding, and tool charges are excluded.
pricing.referenceNotice: Prices were manually synced from official provider pages on {date}. Providers may update list prices later.
pricing.billingNotice: If a model price in the dashboard differs from this page, dashboard configuration is the effective billing source.

providers.openai: Current flagship and coding-oriented token prices published by OpenAI.
providers.gemini: Current Gemini 3 / 3.1 public token prices for the main text and multimodal preview models.
